meta.title: Residency OSCE History-Taking Trainer (Internal Medicine)
meta.description: Say "start exam" and the assistant draws a case and plays the standardized patient; say "end exam" and it switches to examiner, scoring the interview against the official 100-point rubric with itemized deductions and ready-to-copy replacement questions. Ships 32 internal-medicine case scripts (29 in-scope + 3 hematology extras), 4 rule handbooks and an auto-saved training log. For exam practice and teaching simulation only; not medical advice.
